tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current job postings by keyword, title, company, place, pay and date. Call list_fields for filter names. Country and employment_type accept comma-separated values or arrays. Pages return up to 50 jobs (limit, default 10), or 10 when descriptions is "full". Pass next_cursor as cursor for the n

tools.name: count_jobs
tools.description: Count matching jobs without listing them. This is the live count; prefer it over market_lookup and market_breakdown for "how many" and "which employers are hiring". tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get a job by job_id. Default shape matches search_jobs, plus the full description, currentness, stale, last_checked_at, and linked postings. Pass view: "full" for every REST field, or fields to pick top-level properties (job_id is always included).

tools.name: market_breakdown
tools.description: Rank one dimension (by: title, state, city, company, seniority, employment_type or remote) by jobs, pay or another figure, optionally inside a filter. Daily snapshot (see as_of). For live counts or who is hiring now, use count_jobs. Cells with fewer than 30 jobs are omitted. No account needed.

tools.name: market_lookup
tools.description: Look up job count, pay, pay share, work arrangement, posting age, new postings or top employers for up to two of title, place, company, seniority, employment_type and remote. Omit metric for every figure. Daily snapshot (see as_of). For live counts or who is hiring now, use count_jobs. Cells with fe

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: Find search_jobs filters and job fields matching keywords, with type and a short description. Pass words such as ["pay", "remote"]; no keywords lists everything. kind is filter, option (sort, a search_jobs argument beside filters) or field (postings[].x is a posting property). A field state object s

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Headcount Labs docs (filters, limits, MCP setup, errors) and return matching sections with URLs. Works without an account.

tools.name: market_dimensions
tools.description: List dimensions and metrics for market_lookup, market_breakdown and salary_range; pass dimension (and optional q) to list that dimension's values. No account needed.

tools.name: salary_range
tools.description: Posted pay percentiles (25/50/75/90) for a title, place (default US) and optional seniority, with sample size and a short recommendation. Daily snapshot (see as_of). For live counts or who is hiring now, use count_jobs. Cells with fewer than 30 jobs are omitted. No account needed.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "count_jobs" is 1551 chars, far longer than this server's median (294). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, search_docs · Public sink: market_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, search_docs · Public sink: market_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_docs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Works without an account." → after: "Search Headcount Labs docs (filters, limits, MCP setup, errors) and return matching sections with URLs. Works without an account."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
